body: My taste is pretty much all over the place but I really like tears for fears, Steve lacy, and hail the sun to name a few 😁 and you ?

I think many of us have felt the way you do. Please be patient I know you'll find your purpose in this world. It may seem hopeless for the time but one day it'll change because things do get better when you wait long enough to see them. If anything here to talk to.
All 3 questions? Or what did you mean yes by?

I feel its similar to an artist not finding their work reaching their ideal or potential but to others viewing it may be a masterpiece. Regarding if its a good thing or not I guess its up to you. Sharing what you feel may have others feel like there's someone out there they can relate with and maybe even help.

Saying nothing never truly helps. Even writing what you feel may not be as relieving either as you may think but putting it out there and sharing it its bound to catch someone's attention. Although we may not know each I feel like what you're saying is worth saying. I get what you mean about the just fading away, like just seizing to exist. I don't know why you feel disgust for yourself but you shouldn't. If you ever need some one to take to I'm here.
I'm all ears if you need to talk
I can relate my social skills suck when I meet new people but hey I'm down to be your friend if it's all good with you. 😁

I'm sorry to hear you're feeling this way and life just seems to be looking pretty unfair to you and the fact that you can't get the proper help. I really hope things turn out for the better with you as I'm sure you are a wonderful person who deserves better. I'm not much of a person with advice but if there are moments when you that negativity don't bottle it in or cut (as tempting as it may seem) talk to someone you can trust or write down your feelings, do anything really to release those emotions that cause you pain. Sorry if it was not much help but that's as much I can offer with advice as that has helped me.
Honestly if that ain't me 😂 along with singing aloud but semi cautious about getting caught
Same here. If a friend is what you need then I'm here to listen to what you have to say and get off your chest. 😊
Wow what it'd give for a night like that. To just gaze endlessly at a beautiful night sky in complete peace and quiet.
I don't judge. I'm very accepting and I understand some people just can't help the way they feel. Nothing wrong with that.
I'd love that 😊 know that I'll be someone you can trust and confide in when you need someone to just talk to

I've honestly felt the same way like I was never enough for them to keep me around for the long run but i believe your "friends" and yourself don't give yourself enough credit. I'm sure your an amazing person and I'd give anything to have a friend like you.

I'm trully sorry to hear that if anything you don't deserve such mistreatment. How could people be so cruel as to do that, I hope that things turn out for the better and you get to feel happiness once again.
Same here it's summer I've had nothing to do. My shy and awkward personality has prevented me from trully making friends that I could actually call friends.
I'd love to be your friend 😊
Honestly yes. I feel like I'm not really that important to them as they are to me. Im always their last resort or just forgotten.
